entries.title: PostReady: PR #792 — Motion Post engine: real Bring to Life video generation (#698)
entries.description: Wired the Motion Post engine to actually generate Bring to Life videos — the full generation pipeline (prompt → model call → asset storage → result) is now live. Completes epic item #698.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #794 — Motion Post: clean download via proxy + consistent copy
entries.description: Two fixes from Pete's first live Motion Post: (1) Download used a direct r2.dev fetch that CORS-blocks — now proxied through /api/generate-video/download so it saves cleanly. (2) Copy mismatch aligned on Download.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #795 — Motion Post saves to Post Packs as own item
entries.description: A finished Motion Post ("Bring to Life") can now be saved into Post Packs as its own, separate item — non-destructively. The original still's pack is never touched; the Motion Post gets its own dedicated pack entry.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #796 — Real Living Photo (cinemagraph) single-element motion
entries.description: Shipped real Living Photo generation — single-element cinemagraph motion (#764). Bring to Life now supports both full Motion Posts and targeted single-element Living Photos, completing the Bring to Life epic.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #797 — Bring to Life: Before → After reveal (#765)
entries.description: New Bring to Life mode that reveals a BEFORE image transitioning to an AFTER image — the classic trades/cleaners 'look what we did' clip. Deterministic ffmpeg xfade composite (cross-dissolve / wipe), not a model render. No prompt, no generated pixels. Uses same motion_posts ledger row as Motion Post.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #798 — Bring to Life: Atmosphere overlay pack (snow / rain / sun rays / sparkle / mist)
entries.description: New Atmosphere effect family for Bring to Life (#766): weather/sparkle elements composited over a finished still — Snow, Rain, Sun Rays, Sparkle, Mist. Subject and scene are never altered; only the overlay animates. Built cinemagraph-style with deterministic Kling recipes computed app-side — no worker change, no ffmpeg, no bundled assets.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #799 — Bring to Life: Sway effect (fills 3×3 effect grid)
entries.description: Added a 9th Bring to Life effect — Sway (soft, organic camera drift) — completing the 3×3 effect grid with no blank corner. Implemented as a Kling camera-move recipe computed app-side, no worker redeploy needed.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #801 — One customer plan: $39.97/mo, unlimited images (fair-use) (H2 #702)
entries.description: Collapsed billing to one customer-facing plan: $39.97/mo with a fair-use ceiling of 150 AI images/month (abuse guardrail, 95%+ of users never approach it). Everything customer-facing reads "unlimited". No tiers, no add-ons, no upgrade path. 7-day free trial preserved. Full entitlement gating migrated.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #800 — Pricing page: one plan ($39.97/mo, everything included) (H5 #705)
entries.description: Rebuilt the pricing page around a single plan: $39.97/month, everything included, 7-day free trial. Replaces the 3-column Starter/Pro/Business tier comparison. Headline value is Unlimited (unlimited AI images + unlimited posting with own photos). Annual billing and add-ons removed.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #802 — Redesign Batch Create page to match approved mockup
entries.description: Batch Create page redesigned to match the approved owner mockup — aligned with the Create tab's design system. Brings Batch's layout, typography, and UI patterns in line with the rest of the app.
